transitions.rule: a region counts a different-material neighbor as connected (runs full-bleed to that edge) when the pair is in flushPairs, or when the neighbor has the HIGHER matPriority and the pair is not in gutterPairs; the higher-priority cell draws its masked edge tile over an underlay of its dominant lower-priority neighbor material at full mask (mask 255 / corner 15 / seamless fill). gutterPairs connect neither way: both sides edge against the soil underlay. Wet materials sit at priority 30 with their own shoreline/bank rules. Sand (mat 3) is corner16: its pairs follow matPriority like everything else, but on the sand side the dual-grid FIELD extends one cell under any higher-priority land neighbor (and into shoreline water), so the marching band never fires at those seams — the higher side draws its edge over a corner-15 sand underlay.

semanticIds.ramp: ramp.<type name>.dir_<n|e|s|w>.variant_## (grid byte = type*8+dir; dir = ascent)
